name: com.getmcpads/tiktok-ads
title: TikTok Ads
description: TikTok Ads MCP server: 35 read tools, 30 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: TIKTOK_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: App ID the token belongs to.

environmentVariables.name: TIKTOK_ADVERTISER_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated advertiser IDs this server may access. Recommended; required from 3.0.0.

environmentVariables.name: TIKTOK_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: App secret, for endpoints needing app authentication.

environmentVariables.name: TIKTOK_ADVERTISER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default advertiser ID. When TIKTOK_ADVERTISER_IDS is set, must be one of them.

environmentVariables.name: TIKTOK_BC_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Business Center ID, for Business Center scoped reads.

environmentVariables.name: TIKTOK_BUSINESS_CENTER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Alias of TIKTOK_BC_ID, read when TIKTOK_BC_ID is unset.

environmentVariables.name: TIKTOK_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true exposes 30 write tools. Defaults to false. Calls preview unless confirm is true.

environmentVariables.name: TIKTOK_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: production (default) or sandbox. Sandbox binds every call to one advertiser ID.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: debug, info (default), warn or error. Logs go to stderr.
